CustomField.description: IM-232:This will inform the start year for an initiative based on its record type. For Budgeted Initiative, Start year is taken form Start Date in IM where as for Misc Initiatives it will come from Bgive. IM-259: Field has been converted to Text from Number due to incorrect rendering on List Views.
CustomField.formula: IF((RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Budgeted_Initiative' || RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Amendment'), TEXT(YEAR(Start_Date__c)) , IF( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Budgeted_Initiative', Earliest_Payment_Year__c, '' ))
CustomField.label: Start Year
